title: Candidacy Portfolio
description: Enrollment for duration of their preparations for their candidacy portfolio. This begins at the time a student begins preparations for candidacy and continues until candidacy requirements have been completed.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENSH 693, ENGL 693.

CSPT candidacy portfolio requirements differ from non-CSPT requirements for doctoral students. Please see program page for English (Doctor of Philosophy) Concentration in Cultural, Social and Political Thought for details.
